oneLine: Peak XV Partners and Sequoia Capital likely to sell shares in Groww via block deal.

sources.title: Groww Block Deal: Peak XV Partners, Sequoia Capital likely to sell shares at ₹191

synopsis: Peak XV Partners Investments VI-1 and Sequoia Capital Global Growth Fund III - U.S./India Annex Fund, L.P. are likely to sell shares of Billionbrains Garage Ventures Ltd, the parent company of Groww, through a block deal. The floor price is set at ₹191.45 per share, representing a 3.1% discount to the last closing price. The base offer size amounts to ₹19.18 crore, comprising up to 1.6% of the company's existing total shares outstanding. The transaction includes a 30-day lock-up on further sales. The article also notes recent financial results for Groww, showing flat sequential revenue at ₹1,501 crore and a net profit growth of 7% to ₹735 crore for the quarter.
